questions.q: Why does provisioning an Event Hub in Terraform always require two resources, not one?
options: An Event Hub has to exist inside a namespace resource, the same way a database needs a server
Terraform requires every resource to be declared twice for validation
azurerm_eventhub_namespace and azurerm_eventhub are two names for the exact same resource
It's only two resources if you're using the Premium SKU
questions.explain: A namespace is the container an Event Hub client actually connects to — you can't have an Event Hub without one.

questions.q: How does azurerm_eventhub link itself to its namespace in the resource block?
options: Via namespace_id, a reference to the namespace resource's id attribute
Via a hardcoded namespace name string
Automatically, with no field required
Via a separate azurerm_eventhub_link resource
questions.explain: namespace_id = azurerm_eventhub_namespace.example.id is a resource reference, which also creates the dependency ordering Terraform needs.

questions.q: What concept from Fabric & Real-Time Analytics Lesson 20 does partition_count correspond to?
options: The number of partitions enabling multiple consumers to read in parallel
The number of Event Hub namespaces in a subscription
The retention window for events
The throughput tier of the namespace
questions.explain: Lesson 20 taught partitioning as what allows parallel consumption; partition_count is where that choice is set in Terraform.

options: The number of days events remain available, giving a lagging consumer time to catch up
The number of partitions in the Event Hub
The number of namespaces allowed per resource group
The maximum message size accepted by the hub
questions.explain: Retention is the window a consumer that's fallen behind still has to read events before they age out.

questions.q: What happens if you later try to change a namespace's sku into Premium?
options: It forces the creation of a new resource, since Premium is a different SKU family, not a bigger Standard
Nothing changes — capacity is simply increased in place
Terraform automatically migrates all Event Hubs to a new namespace
Premium can only be set via the Azure Portal, never in Terraform
questions.explain: Changing into the Premium SKU is documented as forcing a new resource rather than an in-place update.
